category: link container / link protector with a public HTTP API

free_tier.stated: A protect API is published with no account field: POST https://safelinking.net/api with 'links-to-protect' mandatory and optional captcha, password, title, provider and mirror fields, plus rsdf/dlc/rtc/cnl2 container output. No price list or quota appears on the API page or the front page.
free_tier.notes: The front page is the same form with 'Mirrors', 'Package details' and 'Security Options' (captcha, package password, IP filtering). Nothing on it names a limit.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: it protects link lists; the linked host's cap applies when the file is fetched.

retention.stated: unverified: no retention statement found. Old links (a 2018 post cites two) were still being discussed, but none was fetched successfully today.

egress.terms: No egress of its own: a package page sends the visitor to the host links.

interface_detail: Two documented HTTP endpoints: POST /api to protect (returns the package URL) and GET /check?link=<package>&output=JSON|XML for a link_status check. Container exports: RSDF, DLC, CCF and CNL2. Short links on sflk.in.
tooling: Any HTTP client; the API is form-encoded and documented in the project's GitHub README. JDownloader has a safelinking decrypter.
chaining: It is the indirection half of a pipeline: protect a set of host links, then hand the package URL to a downloader. It does not resolve to direct links and does not bypass any host limit.

limits.value: captcha is optional but on by default in the form (recaptcha or fancy captcha)

limits_note: No byte quota, no account quota and no per-day generation count is published.
binding_note: Nothing in the vocabulary binds at 1 TiB/month because no bytes pass through Safelinking; the only gate is its optional captcha on creation.

identity_cost.detail: The API documentation lists no credential parameter. The 2011-era competitors required username:password; this one's protect call does not. Not confirmed end to end because the host did not answer a direct request.

reliability_note: The domain did not complete a TCP connection from this host: two probes timed out after 21 s (connect error 10060) while the broker returned a provider snapshot of the same page. Treat reachability as location-dependent, not as uptime.
confidence_note: The page text is a provider snapshot rather than a live origin read, and both direct probes timed out, so the record is third-party until a request succeeds from a client network. A measured rung needs one successful /check call.

evidence.proved: the protect API at https://safelinking.net/api with 'links-to-protect' mandatory and no credential field; the /check?link=&output=JSON|XML status endpoint; rsdf/dlc/rtc/cnl2 outputs

notes: Answers half question negatively: it will mint a protected link anonymously over HTTP, but it does not resolve anything to a direct link and it adds a captcha rather than removing one. If the client wants a wrapper, the API exists and is documented; if the client wants direct links, this is not it.
